page.overview:
Who is Elevator Mercenary?

The Elevator Mercenary was a mercenary serving as security at Lockwood Manor. During the Lockwood Manor Auction, he guarded the private elevator. He heard the doors "ding" behind him and turned, and was surprised to discover Stiggy there. Upon seeing him, the dinosaur headbutted the mercenary, sending him flying into the crowd of bidders. He wasn't seriously injured, however, and later got up and fled along with everyone else when the auction plunged into chaos.
